clusters.reason: The PR modified chunk error messages to omit 'or indefinite string type (0x7F)' when inside an indefinite-length string, which changes the exception message for invalid chunks as intended.
The PR introduces specific error messages for nested indefinite-length strings and binary arrays, matching the substring checks in these regression tests.
Nested indefinite-length strings are now correctly rejected per RFC 8949 §3.2.3, causing ordered_json parsing to throw a parse error.
The PR explicitly changes behavior to reject nested indefinite-length CBOR strings with parse_error.113.
The PR explicitly changes behavior to reject nested indefinite-length CBOR binary arrays with parse_error.113.
The PR rejects any second indefinite-length marker inside an indefinite-length string, preventing deeply nested or recursive chunks.
The chunk error message update correctly drops the mention of indefinite types when inside an indefinite-length context.
SAX parsing now correctly reports a parse error when encountering invalid nested indefinite-length strings.
When exceptions are disabled, parsing invalid nested indefinite-length strings correctly returns a discarded json value.
Nested indefinite-length strings inside arrays are correctly rejected with parse_error.113.
Nested indefinite-length strings used as object keys are correctly rejected with parse_error.113.
Deeply nested indefinite-length binary arrays are caught early at the second indefinite marker with parse_error.113 instead of failing later on EOF.
